note: Hand-written gold set for bench/run.ts. Each `relevant` entry names a corpus document and an `anchor` — a distinctive phrase that must appear in the retrieved chunk's excerpt. Anchors deliberately avoid chunk ids and headings: both move when chunking changes, and the point of this set is to survive that. Questions are phrased the way a teammate would ask, not by restating the sentence they should match.
styles: `style` defaults to "sentence". The "keyword" ones at the end are what an agent sends when it already knows the term, and they exist because a lexical arm with OR semantics trades precision for recall: short queries are the case that could get worse without any aggregate showing it. Scored separately for that reason.
